nodes.label: INSIGHT Treatment Plan Module
nodes.description: Independently deployable INSIGHT module for producing explainable, patient-specific treatment-plan recommendations with structured psychiatrist review and immutable finalized plans.

nodes.label: INSIGHT Platform
nodes.description: Clinical decision support platform for schizophrenia care, composed of multiple independently deployable modules.

nodes.label: FastAPI Backend
nodes.description: Python backend application using FastAPI, exposing a versioned REST API at /api/treatment-plan/v1.

nodes.label: React Frontend
nodes.description: React application (built with Vite) providing the psychiatrist review workspace UI.

nodes.label: Psychiatrist Review Workspace
nodes.description: React-based UI for reviewing and editing the primary treatment plan before finalization.

nodes.label: Authentication Service
nodes.description: Central INSIGHT Authentication module; all protected routes delegate session validation to this service via REST.

nodes.label: Diagnosis Module
nodes.description: Upstream INSIGHT module providing diagnosis assessments via REST; owns diagnosis assessment entities.

nodes.label: Severity Module
nodes.description: Upstream INSIGHT module providing severity assessments via REST.

nodes.label: Medical History Module
nodes.description: Upstream INSIGHT module providing medical history data via REST.

nodes.label: DDI Checker Service
nodes.description: Upstream INSIGHT module for Drug-Drug Interaction checks; called via versioned REST.

nodes.label: BN Manager Service
nodes.description: Upstream INSIGHT module managing Bayesian Network model evaluations; called via REST.

nodes.label: Add New Patient Module
nodes.description: Upstream INSIGHT module providing patient and encounter data via REST.

nodes.label: SQLite
nodes.description: Default persistence implementation for the Treatment Plan repository pattern.

nodes.label: InMemoryRepository
nodes.description: In-memory repository implementation used during testing.

nodes.label: FastAPI
nodes.description: Python web framework used for the Treatment Plan backend; version >=0.115,<1.

nodes.label: Vite
nodes.description: Frontend build tool used to build the React application.

nodes.label: Docker Compose
nodes.description: Container orchestration file (compose.yaml) for running the application.

nodes.label: OpenAPI Specification
nodes.description: External REST interface contract for the Treatment Plan module; located in contracts/.

nodes.label: JSON Schemas
nodes.description: Data contract schemas for Treatment Plan entities; versioned at 1.0.0, located in contracts/.

nodes.label: Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
nodes.description: Governance documents recording architectural decisions; stored in governance/ directory.

nodes.label: README.md
nodes.description: Module documentation for the INSIGHT Treatment Plan; describes architecture, capabilities, and usage.

nodes.label: Psychiatrist
nodes.description: Clinical role that acts as the final authority; reviews, modifies, and finalizes treatment plans.

nodes.label: CSRF Protection
nodes.description: Security mechanism required for all mutating API requests in the Treatment Plan module.

nodes.label: Immutable Final Treatment Plan
nodes.description: The finalized treatment plan stored immutably with complete data provenance, including exact source versions.

nodes.label: Bayesian Network (BN) Model
nodes.description: Probabilistic graphical model used for generating treatment recommendations; orchestrated by BnEvaluationOrchestrator.

nodes.label: REST API
nodes.description: Communication protocol used exclusively between all INSIGHT modules; direct cross-module database access is forbidden.

nodes.label: Data Provenance
nodes.description: Complete record of exact source data versions used in a finalized treatment plan decision; stored immutably.

nodes.label: Append-Only Edit Ledger
nodes.description: Immutable, append-only log tracking all edits to a plan with strong concurrency control and attribution.

nodes.label: Database Migrations
nodes.description: Database schema migrations for the Treatment Plan module; located in treatment_plan/migrations.

nodes.label: run.ps1
nodes.description: PowerShell script to start the FastAPI backend server.

nodes.label: test.ps1
nodes.description: PowerShell script to run the complete backend test suite.

nodes.label: Python 3.10+
nodes.description: Minimum required Python version for the backend.

nodes.label: Node.js 18+
nodes.description: Minimum required Node.js version for the frontend.
